choices.label: Good Old Rock
choices.description: When you play Rock, a loss becomes a draw.

choices.label: Chimera
choices.description: Your Lizard also beats Scissors, all match.

choices.label: Ferrus
choices.description: When you play Robot, the move they played takes an extra mark.

choices.label: Quarantine
choices.description: Name a move. If they play it, it takes 2 extra marks.

choices.label: Oracle
choices.description: Secretly learn one live move they had not chosen, then re-pick.

choices.label: Sacrifice
choices.description: Secretly declare the round a draw before picking, and clear all your marks.

choices.label: Rust
choices.description: Secretly add a mark to a move already on their cooldown.

choices.label: Thief
choices.description: Secretly move one mark from one of your moves onto one of theirs.

choices.label: Freeze
choices.description: Stop their marks decrementing this round.

choices.label: Tripwire
choices.description: Secretly arm a trap on a move. If they play it, it takes 2 extra marks.

choices.label: Echo Chamber
choices.description: On a drawn round, their move takes an extra mark.

choices.label: Sharp Practice
choices.description: A Scissors mirror is a win for you, not a draw.

choices.label: Grudge
choices.description: From your second loss onward, the move that beat you takes an extra mark for them.

choices.label: Tempered
choices.description: Your losing move takes 1 mark instead of 2.

choices.label: Featherweight
choices.description: Your Lizard takes 1 mark instead of 2.

choices.label: Small Mercy
choices.description: The first round you lose, the move that beat you takes an extra mark.

choices.label: Well Oiled
choices.description: Your Robot takes 1 mark instead of 2.

choices.label: Flywheel
choices.description: Secretly clear a mark from every move you have on cooldown.

choices.label: Feint
choices.description: Secretly name one of your moves. This round's marks land on it instead.

choices.label: Prologue
choices.description: Your first two moves of the match take 1 mark instead of 2.

choices.label: Poker Face
choices.description: The opponent is never told you have locked in.

choices.label: Copycat
choices.description: On a drawn round, your move takes 1 mark instead of 2.

choices.label: Bookend
choices.description: Your first move of the match takes 1 mark instead of 2.

choices.label: Old Habits
choices.description: You are shown which move the opponent has played most this match.

choices.label: Watchful
choices.description: You are shown the opponent's cooldowns as they will stand next round.
